what: Face matching thresholds, measured on LFW (62 people with 20+ photos, 900 photos sampled with seed 0). Development data only; no face data is kept in the repository.
detected: 900/900 photos, 18 ms a photo on a laptop CPU (detect + align + embed)

chosen.why: a merge is the costly mistake (it puts one person's edits on another), so the match line sits where false merges are 1 in 11,000 pairs; the band below it is reported as unsure and never merged

limits: LFW is near-frontal, well lit and centred. Video has profile views, motion blur, masks, tiny faces and children, where agreement is lower; those show up as unsure or as separate people, not as wrong merges, because the match line is strict.
